what: One Crash round hash, copied from Gamdom's Crash verifier page on 1 November 2026
notRecorded: the round's game id, time and crash point
whyItCounts: Each round's hash is the SHA-256 of the next round's hash, so only the operator holding the chain can produce a hash further along it. Walking back from this hash reaches the newest 31 October round (scripts/live-chain-check.mjs), so it is a later round on the same chain.
